heuristics.rule: Apply for PGWP within 180 days of receiving final marks, regardless of where you are located
heuristics.condition: When a student has graduated from an eligible Canadian DLI and is deciding when and where to apply for PGWP
heuristics.action: Submit the PGWP application within 180 days of the school issuing final marks — can be done from inside Canada or from abroad
heuristics.because: IRCC explicitly allows overseas PGWP applications and the 180-day window is the binding constraint, not physical location

heuristics.rule: Ensure passport validity covers the full intended PGWP duration before applying
heuristics.condition: When applying for PGWP and your passport expires before the maximum eligible PGWP length
heuristics.action: Renew passport before submitting PGWP application so it covers the full 3-year (or applicable) period
heuristics.because: IRCC will only issue a PGWP valid until the passport expiry date, shortening the work authorization period if passport expires early

heuristics.rule: Change status to visitor if study permit expires before PGWP application is submitted and you remain in Canada
heuristics.condition: When a graduate's study permit will expire before they are ready to submit the PGWP application and they intend to stay in Canada
heuristics.action: Apply to change status to visitor; this can be done up to 90 days after study permit expiry to restore status
heuristics.because: Overstaying a study permit without changing status creates an implied status or restoration gap that can complicate the PGWP application

decision_factors.factor: Passport expiry date relative to PGWP eligibility length
decision_factors.why_it_matters: IRCC caps PGWP validity at passport expiry, so a soon-expiring passport directly reduces the work authorization window even if the applicant qualifies for 3 years
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Compare passport expiry date against the maximum PGWP duration you qualify for (up to 3 years for programs 2 years or longer); if passport expires sooner, renew first

decision_factors.factor: Program length and whether the DLI is PGWP-eligible
decision_factors.why_it_matters: Only graduates of designated learning institutions with eligible programs qualify; program length determines whether a 3-year PGWP is available
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Verify DLI designation and confirm program was 2 years or more full-time to qualify for the maximum 3-year PGWP

decision_factors.factor: Time elapsed since final marks were issued
decision_factors.why_it_matters: The 180-day application window is a hard deadline; missing it forfeits PGWP eligibility entirely
decision_factors.how_to_assess: Track the exact date the school issued final marks or transcript and count forward 180 days; plan any travel or delay accordingly

hidden_tradeoffs.choice: Returning home after graduation before applying for PGWP
hidden_tradeoffs.unstated_consequence: The 180-day clock keeps running while abroad; extended travel or delays at home can erode the window, and any re-entry to Canada will require a valid visa or eTA, adding a potential barrier if documents are not prepared in advance
hidden_tradeoffs.who_it_affects: Graduates who underestimate processing times or visa requirements for re-entry to Canada after going home

hidden_tradeoffs.choice: Applying for a PGWP without first renewing an expiring passport
hidden_tradeoffs.unstated_consequence: The PGWP will be issued only until passport expiry, permanently losing months or years of work authorization that cannot be recovered by later renewing the passport
hidden_tradeoffs.who_it_affects: Any PGWP applicant whose passport expires within 3 years of graduation

failure_patterns.pattern: Missing the 180-day PGWP application deadline due to extended post-graduation travel or delays at home
failure_patterns.why_it_happens: Graduates feel the 180-day window is ample and underestimate how quickly it passes when combining travel, rest, document preparation, and processing delays
failure_patterns.consequence: Permanent loss of PGWP eligibility for that graduation, forcing the graduate to seek other work permit pathways or lose the immigration advantage entirely
warning_signs: Planning to 'relax at home for a few months' before thinking about PGWP
No concrete date set for when the PGWP application will be submitted

diagnostic_questions.question: When exactly did your school issue your final marks or transcript?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: This is the start date of the 180-day PGWP application window — without knowing this date precisely, the applicant cannot assess their remaining time
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Calculate the exact deadline and work backward to set a submission date with buffer for document preparation
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Contact the registrar immediately to confirm the official mark-issue date before making any travel plans

diagnostic_questions.question: Does your passport remain valid for the full duration of the PGWP you are eligible for?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the applicant will receive a truncated PGWP due to passport expiry, reducing their work and immigration runway
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Proceed with PGWP application without passport renewal
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: Renew passport before submitting PGWP application to avoid losing work authorization time

diagnostic_questions.question: Will your study permit expire before you plan to submit your PGWP application, and do you intend to stay in Canada during that gap?
diagnostic_questions.what_it_reveals: Whether the applicant needs to change status to visitor to maintain lawful status in Canada during the gap period
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_yes: Apply to change status to visitor before study permit expires or within 90 days after expiry to restore status
diagnostic_questions.follow_up_if_no: No immediate status action required, but monitor permit expiry date closely

industry_realities.common_belief: You must be physically inside Canada to apply for PGWP after graduation
industry_realities.actual_reality: PGWP can be applied for online from outside Canada (i.e., from abroad), as long as eligibility criteria are met and the 180-day window has not expired
industry_realities.implication: Graduates can return home after graduation and still apply for PGWP remotely, giving them flexibility — but this does not pause the 180-day deadline

industry_realities.common_belief: PGWP is automatically available to any Canadian university or college graduate
industry_realities.actual_reality: PGWP eligibility depends on the specific DLI being designated and the program meeting eligibility criteria; not all institutions or programs qualify
industry_realities.implication: Students should verify their DLI's PGWP eligibility before or during enrollment, not after graduation when it is too late to switch

junior_vs_senior_signals.dimension: Understanding of PGWP application location flexibility
junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Assumes they must stay in Canada continuously after graduation to apply for PGWP, or that leaving Canada forfeits eligibility
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Knows the application can be submitted from anywhere within the 180-day window and plans travel accordingly without anxiety about location
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: Naive belief can cause unnecessary stress or rushed decisions about staying in Canada; informed understanding enables deliberate post-graduation planning

junior_vs_senior_signals.naive_pattern: Views six months as a long, relaxed window and delays thinking about PGWP until well into the period
junior_vs_senior_signals.informed_pattern: Treats the 180-day window as finite and sets a concrete submission target early, accounting for document gathering, passport renewal if needed, and processing time
junior_vs_senior_signals.why_it_matters: Missing the deadline is an unrecoverable error; experienced graduates treat it with the same seriousness as a visa expiry

community_misconceptions.misconception: As long as you apply within 180 days, you can take as much time as you want after graduation without any status concerns in Canada
community_misconceptions.why_believed: The 180-day rule sounds generous and the focus is on the application deadline, not on maintaining lawful status during the intervening period
community_misconceptions.actual_rule: If your study permit expires before you submit the PGWP application and you are still in Canada, you must change status to visitor to remain lawfully present; you have up to 90 days after study permit expiry to restore status
community_misconceptions.real_consequence: A graduate who remains in Canada after their study permit expires without changing status may accumulate unauthorized days, complicating the PGWP application or future immigration applications

psychological_barriers.trigger: Asking whether it is possible to go home first and come back later to do PGWP — framed as a binary permission question
psychological_barriers.underlying_state: Anxiety that leaving Canada after graduation will permanently close off the PGWP pathway; fear of making an irreversible mistake by traveling
psychological_barriers.how_it_manifests: The poster frames the question as 'can I do this at all?' rather than 'what do I need to ensure if I do this?' — seeking permission rather than planning
psychological_barriers.expert_move: Reframe from 'is it allowed?' to 'what are the exact conditions and deadlines I must satisfy?' — which converts fear into a concrete checklist and removes the paralysis

reframing_moves.original_framing: 'Can I go home after graduation and still get PGWP?' — framed as a yes/no permission question about location
reframing_moves.reframe: The binding constraint is the 180-day deadline from final marks, not your physical location — Canada allows overseas applications and still wants you back; the question is whether you manage the timeline and documents correctly
reframing_moves.why_it_works: Shifts the poster's mental model from 'location determines eligibility' to 'timeline and document readiness determine eligibility,' replacing geographic anxiety with an actionable checklist
reframing_moves.example_language: 毕业后有长达半年的时间可以do whatever excites you wherever you want, and Canada still wants you back — 玩心不要超过半年就可以
